tractability_bound_declared_now.statement: Given measured per-trial cost (~130s/candidate x 8 calibration sequences for a full causal-simulation trial, ~20s/sequence for a static-point score), the following is the COMPLETE additional work this broadening will trigger, decided now, before any result is seen:
steps: 1. Generate calibration-split cache at resolutions {896,1728} x NMS {0.45,0.60,0.70} (new GPU work, ~35 min on T4).
2. Re-run the oracle/headroom gate on the full 15-point broadened static-point set, 8 calibration sequences, ByteTrack host (~800s CPU).

3. DECISION POINT (evidence-based, not outcome-chasing): if the broadened oracle headroom (best-per-sequence hindsight vs the new best matched-static, mean per-sequence HOTA) is still <= the original narrow-space headroom (0.178) and still concentrated in <=1-2 sequences, this constitutes sufficient evidence that broadening the action space does not change the qualitative finding; the staged controller search (Stage 1/2/3A/3B/Stage4) is NOT re-run on the broadened space, and the narrow-space staged results already in progress stand as the complete controller-development evidence. If the broadened oracle headroom is MEANINGFULLY larger and more broadly distributed, the staged pipeline (Stage 1/2/3A/3B/Stage4 pattern) IS re-run on the broadened action space before freeze.
4. This decision rule is fixed now; it will not be loosened or tightened after step 2's result is seen.
